title: Quantifying Backlinks Quality — The Bare Minimum
summary: How to quantify backlink quality in a way that properly rewards higher-DR links. Since DR operates on a logarithmic scale, a linear points system undervalues high-authority links. This episode shares a scoring sheet to assign and track goals for your outreach team members more accurately.
show_notes_text:
### Quantifying Backlinks Quality — The Bare Minimum

One reason to move away from a simple link-count metric: the DR range of 1–100 is **not a linear scale — it's logarithmic**. Earning a DR70 link is exponentially harder than a DR30, so your scoring system should reflect that.

This system grants significantly more points to higher-DR links, which makes for fairer goal-setting and rewards for your outreach team.
